worldcombat.skill.stringshot.summary: Shoot a flying strand of silk from your mouth to bind a foe, harshly lowering its Speed and briefly pinning its feet; a missed strand sticks to the ground as a small web. You may also spin the silk into a net that traps whoever walks in.
worldcombat.skill.stringshot.use.0: Stop a charging or fleeing enemy
worldcombat.skill.stringshot.description: A bound target loses %1$s Speed stage(s) for %2$s; a Bind hit also pins it for %3$s.
A Net hit lays a web of radius %1$s at the landing point that lasts %2$s and traps enemies walking through.
The strand flies at %1$s with a %2$s hit radius, reaches %3$s blocks over a %4$s range, and winds up for %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.stringshot.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
On: the strand lands at the target point and spreads a sticky web with longer reach, but no pin, slower windup and a longer cooldown. Off: bind one target with a fast shot that also pins it briefly.
The companion only considers a strand while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts earlier.
In Net posture the companion only spins a web with at least this many enemies around the target; 1 means lay it on sight.
In Bind posture, when on, the companion only strands fleeing threats to hold them; off, it will strand any threat in range.
When on, the companion may leave its post to strand under a Hold order.
